pages.title: Virtual Photon
pages.text: Light that was never emitted and will never be absorbed, existing only between two charges as the carrier of their force. It glows faintly from no direction in particular and vanishes from view when looked at directly.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Virtual Pairs left these behind in the Quantum Foam. Later I harvested them from between Casimir plates, where they press the plates together in the Casimir effect.

Made in $(item)Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ephemeral Photon Ore$(), in veins through the Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Virtual Pair.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dyson Sphere Model, Eigenstate Lattice, Entangled Photon Pair, Galaxy in a Box, Miniature Pulsar, Miniature White Hole, Pocket Universe Display.
